newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar falls further, ends around lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar falls further, ends around lows.

text.p: White sugar futures remained softer during Tuesday evening trading, as the LIFFE market was depressed further by losses in New York, traders said.
The nearby December contract fell through support at $328.00, with trade selling exerting some pressure on the market, they said.
December closed the session at $327.50, down $2.80, while March slipped to $327.00, a $3.10 loss from Monday. LIFFE turnover was 2,147 lots.
In Paris, December was $1.50 easier at $328.50.
